title: A missing message key renders the text "undefined"
task:
`test/i18n-missing-key.test.mjs` fails.

`translate()` runs `String(template)` on a key it did not find, so a key missing from a locale renders the literal word "undefined" into the page.

Fix the lookup so that a key present in the default catalogue but missing from the requested one falls back to the default locale, and a key missing everywhere returns the key itself. Placeholder interpolation must keep working on the fallback text.

The test directory is read-only for this task.
